scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A fresh decision to defend
scenes.caption: Kabir receives a new fictional exam-fee correction message. A familiar voice and a confident assistant both support it. The message asks for a private transfer, but the independent school notice has not yet confirmed any correction.
scenes.dialogue: Begin with what is known and unknown.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Build an individual explanation
scenes.caption: The student must separate the message’s claim, the supplied evidence, the remaining uncertainty and the next safe action. An alternative should be considered and rejected with a reason, rather than ignored.
scenes.dialogue: Your reasoning matters more than repeating a slogan.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Use the annual portfolio
scenes.caption: Bring a security control, an AI evaluation or source check, an algorithm trace and a payment-verification record. Identify whether each item is your earlier work or a supplied classroom example. The teacher reviews the individual defence.
scenes.dialogue: Automatic checks cannot establish authorship or oral understanding.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Respond to the fresh claim
scenes.caption: Without independent confirmation, should Kabir send a small test payment, follow the assistant’s confidence, or pause and verify through a previously known school contact?
scenes.dialogue: State why the unresolved claim changes the action.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Feedback and a safer revision
scenes.caption: An unsafe answer gets specific feedback and can be revised. Retain the original attempt as evidence of learning. A successful structured check is not an automatic pass for the individual oral explanation.
scenes.dialogue: Explain the repair and what remains uncertain.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the defence lab
scenes.caption: Inspect the fresh case, challenge unsafe assistant advice and prepare a two-minute individual defence with evidence, an alternative and a limitation. Add a short reflection for teacher discussion; its length is not automatically graded.
scenes.dialogue: Defend the decision, then reflect on the next check.
